notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The demo is out now!

We are very excited to see what players make of the game, especially experiencing the ever-changing controls, something we are sure some may take to better than others but hopefully everyone will find it engaging and fun.

The demo includes the first level of the game which is procedurally generated so should have a good level of replayability. We recommend playing with a controller as that is the intended format, however the demo does have keyboard binding as well (however it is currently basic)

Be sure to let us know what you think, any feedback is greatly appreciated. Contact us through the Steam community page, via Twitter https://twitter.com/BananaBreadGame or directly through our site https://bananabreadgames.wordpress.com/contact/ These links can also be found in the game menu so you can let us know what you think even while playing.

Thank you and we hope you have fun! 

Banana Bread Games
